<<NOTES ON AIRING OUT A BOATHOUSE>>

Airing out a boathouse is a vital process that ensures the space is clean, fresh and ready for use. it involves removing all items from the boathouse and allowing the space to dry naturally. this helps to eliminate any lingering odors and prevent the growth of mold or mildew. it is important to keep the boathouse well-ventilated by opening windows and doors, and to use fans if necessary. after the boathouse has dried, it is important to clean and organize the space again. this process is essential for maintaining a safe and pleasant environment for boaters and visitors.
